title: Polynomial-time unary powers
statement: Let $f$ be a function from finite bit strings to the natural numbers, and let $k\in\mathbb N$. If the unary string function $x\mapsto 1^{f(x)}$ is polynomial-time computable, then so is $x\mapsto 1^{f(x)^k}$.
hypotheses_covered: The unary string function determined by $f$ is polynomial-time computable
